task_completion.description: The agent opens the SeisComP graphical interface (e.g., scconfig or scolv) to manage the earthquake data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window showing the SeisComP user interface, such as the configuration manager or the origin locator view.

task_completion.description: The agent accesses or loads the waveform archive located at /home/ga/seiscomp/var/lib/archive.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the file browser or SeisComP settings pointing to the specific archive path /home/ga/seiscomp/var/lib/archive.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies or processes P-wave picks for the Noto earthquake event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Waveform traces in a SeisComP window (like scolv) with vertical markers indicating 'P' phase picks.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates or displays the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) for the identified P-waves.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A table or inspector view within SeisComP showing SNR values associated with specific station picks.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the data to a CSV file at the specified path /home/ga/snr_report.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command or a 'Save As' dialog box showing the file path /home/ga/snr_report.csv.

task_completion.description: The exported CSV contains the correct header: STATION,PHASE,SNR.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A view of the file content (via 'cat' in terminal or a text editor) showing the header row 'STATION,PHASE,SNR' and at least 3 rows of data.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the SeisComP software rather than just creating a manual file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the SeisComP GUI windows and waveform processing, not just a terminal creating a CSV from scratch.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the expected station names and SNR values into a file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen clicking on waveforms or using SeisComP processing tools before the CSV is generated.

integrity.description: The agent used the local archive path provided in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The path /home/ga/seiscomp/var/lib/archive should be visible in the configuration or command logs.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The waveform archive only contains data for three stations: GSI, SANI, and BKB. Although the inventory may list TOLI and KWP, their waveform files (.mseed) are missing. A successful report will contain exactly 3 SNR measurements for GSI, SANI, and BKB. The output must be a CSV at /home/ga/snr_report.csv with the header STATION,PHASE,SNR.
